data.body: Correction: tier is B, not the A initially recommended. pre-commit-design-md-lint.sh LOGIC step 1 'Fail-open on timeout (SIGTERM/SIGURG)' means it fails OPEN on infrastructure failure; the gate-tier doctrine keys tier on infra-failure behavior, so it is Tier B (dev-experience/formatting-lint), not Tier A (which must fail closed). Fixed by adding '# DSO-GATE-TIER: B'. NOTE for owner: the '# hook-boundary: enforcement' annotation usually pairs with Tier A — the enforcement-vs-fail-open-on-timeout tension is a latent design question left in a code comment for the CI/PR owner to resolve.
